title: Supabase management access token missing
affects: M3-T002 (durable content-addressed storage of the ORIGINAL HTML/PDF captures + raw hashes + manifests  -  required before acceptance)
M3-T003 (durable content-addressed storage of rendered pages + extraction/OCR evidence + human-review bundles  -  required before acceptance)
M3-T005 (durable content-addressed storage of the Construction-Code + amendment-overlay corpus  -  required before acceptance)
M2-T019 (production ReviewStore against Supabase with tested RLS + atomic multi-fact confirm, for the survey-review slice  -  required before acceptance)
detail: Supabase MCP server is configured and resolves project URL https://dyiviaalkqxeyyxotvvh.supabase.co, but management operations return Unauthorized. Durable legal-corpus object storage depends on this token, split by the sec.17.16 ownership decision: M3-T002 stores the immutable ORIGINAL HTML/PDF captures (no rendering  -  T002 has no parser/renderer); M3-T003 stores rendered pages + extraction/OCR evidence + review bundles; M3-T005 stores the construction-code + amendment-overlay corpus. Each may develop and gate-review fixture/harness increments while this is open, but none may be ACCEPTED (nor mark its corpus domain 'implemented', nor satisfy a downstream dependency, nor unblock a feasibility claim) until its durable, content-addressed storage exists. This blocker therefore blocks acceptance of M3-T002, M3-T003, and M3-T005 while open (enforced by tools/project_control.py accept: an open blocker whose affects/detail names the task blocks acceptance). The cross-reference closure packet consumes already-stored verified evidence and is not itself a durable-bulk-storage task, so it is deliberately NOT named here; it is gated instead by its dependencies on the accepted capture and evidence tasks. (Scope note, superseding the earlier 'only the three durable-storage tasks' wording, amended 2026-08-11: the record now ALSO names M2-T019. That task is not legal-corpus capture - it is the production ReviewStore for the survey-review slice (the review-action API slice was disclosed by the survey-review UI packet, which is itself accepted against local/CI auth fixtures and is NOT blocked by B-001; only this production ReviewStore follow-up is), which needs the same missing token to exist at all (Supabase Postgres + tested RLS, plus an atomic multi-fact confirm to replace the non-transactional in-process test store). It is named here for the same reason as the other three: it may be developed and gate-reviewed while this is open, but it may not be ACCEPTED until durable production storage exists. The earlier wording claimed an 'S9 regression asserts that exactly'; no test in this repository pins this affects list - the S9 reference is to M2-T015's SB-S9 survey-pipeline scenario, which does not read this record - so that claim is retired here rather than left to imply a guard that does not exist. The cross-reference closure packet remains deliberately NOT named; it is gated by its dependencies on the accepted capture and evidence tasks.) [Precision fix, 2026-08-11 session 16: an earlier draft named the disclosing survey-review UI task by its ledger id in this prose, which the conservative accept-guard (project_control.accept scans affects+detail for a word-bounded task-id match) read as if B-001 blocked that task's acceptance. It does not: the authoritative affects list names M2-T019 (the production ReviewStore), never the UI task, which is accepted against local/CI auth fixtures per its own packet. The id was therefore described generically above so the guard's scope matches the blocker's real intent; no hold was weakened - M3-T002/T003/T005 and M2-T019 remain blocked while B-001 is open.]
exact_human_action: Create a personal access token at https://supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens and add it to the Supabase MCP server configuration as SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN (Claude Code MCP settings), then restart the MCP connection. Do not paste the token into chat, code, or committed files.
where_to_enter: Claude Code MCP server configuration (environment of the supabase MCP server) or the harness secret store
minimum_permissions: Access to the target Supabase organization/projects; token scope is account-level (Supabase PATs are not scoped narrower today)
how_it_will_be_tested: mcp__supabase__list_tables on schema public; expected: table list or empty list, no Unauthorized error. No secret values will be printed.
